title: Medical Record Amendment and Correction Policy
content: A medical record entry may only be amended by the original author (physician, nurse, or allied health staff) to correct a factual error; all amendments must be transparent, never obliterating the original entry. Amendments in the HIS are versioned automatically; the original entry is retained with a timestamp and the amended version shows the date, time, corrector's ID, and reason for amendment. Paper record corrections must be made by drawing a single line through the error, initialing, dating, and writing the correct entry; correction fluid (Wite-Out) is strictly prohibited. Requests for amendment from patients must be reviewed by the Medical Records Supervisor and the treating physician; unjustified changes must be refused with a written explanation to the patient. Mass or systematic record alterations require Medical Director approval and must be logged as a quality event in the HIS.
